fn main() {
    let pw = Ptr(Box::new(Wrapper(5))) as Ptr<Wrapper<dyn Trait>>;
    assert_eq!(pw.ptr_wrapper(), 5);

    let wp = Wrapper(Ptr(Box::new(6))) as Wrapper<Ptr<dyn Trait>>;

}
